Hi Emily —

Thanks again for your interest in Redwood. We'd love to run a 45-minute demo next week focused on throughput/latency and how our Dedicated option could map to your compliance needs. I know you're on US Central time, and our solution/engineering partner (Jonas) will be joining from Europe, so I wanted to propose a few cross-region-friendly slots:

Option A — Tue 10 Mar, 10:00 AM CT / Tue 10 Mar, 17:00 CET
Option B — Tue 10 Mar, 2:00 PM CT / Wed 11 Mar, 01:00 CET (late for EU)
Option C — Wed 11 Mar, 8:00 AM CT / Wed 11 Mar, 15:00 CET

A couple notes: US daylight savings starts on Mar 8 (clocks move forward) and EU switches a week later — that sometimes causes one-week offsets in local times, so I double-checked the conversions. I've attached a small .ics with the proposed primary slot and a quick snapshot that shows the conversions across PST/CT/CET to avoid confusion.

Do any of these work? If not, reply with your preference and timezone and we'll re-run options. If helpful, here's a Calendly link with our open slots: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo

Best,
Marissa
